limits: The missing held-out object clip is scored as misses; no retry or completed-subset headline score.
The interrupted h3 expected command is reconstructed from the freeze; its original runtime argv was not captured.
No held-out data was used for tuning; aliases, targets and inference settings remained frozen.
Published VIPSeg quality control replaces a newly named independent reviewer.
Whether the models were trained on VIPSeg source footage is unknown.
Structural negatives follow the frozen VIPSeg mapping; other stuff classes remain background.
Pan is represented only in development; the blur proxy was checked on one frame pair.
The check dimension is withheld from scale fitting, but its expected length is in the calibration payload for post-fit checks.
Process RSS is not total physical footprint or peak accelerator memory.
The machine was shared with other active workloads; measured runtimes are not a throughput benchmark.
Jev judgments are advisory; retained low-confidence/escalated results are not correctness proof.
Fixture success does not establish recognition accuracy; results apply only to this finite pilot.
